name: codex-orchestrator
description: Dual-Brain orchestration plugin for Google Antigravity (v3.2): Gemini manages scope and frozen corpora while local Codex CLI executes scoped code (/impl, /dag), Git reviews (/review), and structured research/debate/analysis (/research, /debate, /analyze) with verified patch custody and fail-closed evidence.
suggestedPrompts: /impl Write a Spec, delegate scoped implementation to Codex CLI, verify independently, and brief me
/dag Lock a shared contract, run parallel managed-worktree Codex workers with patch custody checks, and brief me
/research Freeze a source corpus, run parallel Codex research and blind critique, spot-check citations, and brief me
